This requires $k$ to be even, $k=2j$.
$(2^m)^2 - 5^{2j} = 3$, or $(2^m - 5^j)(2^m + 5^j) = 3$.
Since $2^m + 5^j > 0$ and $2^m + 5^j > 2^m - 5^j$, the only integer factorization of 3 is $1 \times 3$.
